gc.note: Stop-the-world GC pauses sampled from runtime/metrics /gc/pauses:seconds over EKB_RUNS runs; each quantile is the median across runs (min/max retained); the wall-clock budget is split across runs. peak/retained heap from runtime.MemStats during a soak-style roundtrip + machine-9 decode workload.

notes: CPU shares and allocation/retained sites are go tool pprof tables over the test-binary profiles; values are pprof's own.
GC pause quantiles are bucket midpoints of runtime/metrics /gc/pauses:seconds (stop-the-world pauses only); each quantile is the median across EKB_RUNS runs, with min/max retained.
Heap peak/retained are runtime.MemStats sampled during the representative workload, not the allocation-profile sample.
